long_biography.plain_text:
Art Weiss Industrial Properties began in 1953, when Art Weiss moved from general contracting into development in California's San Gabriel Valley. Matthew Sawyer now leads the enterprise's third generation, overseeing industrial office and warehouse space in California and Arizona. His mandate has been to extend a long-established operating platform rather than simply preserve it.

Sawyer became both a licensed broker and general contractor and developed expertise across acquisitions, construction, management and leasing. His work has included acquiring more than a million square feet of industrial buildings and arranging extensive leasing and commercial finance. He also founded the Asher Foundation to support marine conservation, youth education and community programmes. In 2026, Oceana appointed him to its board, adding institutional responsibility to years of conservation support.
